title: Top Users receiving Phish
description: This query visualises total inbound emails with Phish detections summarizing the data by the top recipient email address (RecipientEmailAddress)
query: ('Log Source' = 'Microsoft Defender Email Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Microsoft 365 Audit Logs') and ('Threat Category' like '*Phish*' and Direction = 'Inbound') | stats count as count_ by 'Target User Name' | sort -count_ | sort -count_ | head 15
